questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (e.g., frames 11-13), the white surface is completely empty; there are zero pens, not three.
There are no pens visible to judge alignment; the board is empty.
There are no pens visible to judge color consistency.
There are no pens visible; therefore, none are capped or complete.
The board moves smoothly and continuously from the left side of the frame to the right side across the sequence without stopping or jamming.
There are no pens to observe for movement relative to the board.

parsed.reason: The board is completely empty when fully in view; it carries zero pens instead of the required three identical pens.

description: A pen is missing; fewer than three pens on the board.
